title: An assignment rule limited to the API channel still assigns imported leads
zohoSource: Zoho CRM help (documentation; the state cannot be produced read-only in the live org)

panels.caption: Channel restriction "Api" is not applied to imports
Zoho: the caller picks one rule
text: Zoho has no per-rule channel list: assignment rules run for import, web form and API, and the import/web form/API call picks the rule.
The channel list is a TAVI addition, so TAVI's own setting is the expected behaviour here.
